rationale: The -14% gap has no identifiable catalyst, and price is stuck mid-range (46.6%) just 1% above VWAP after a high-volume bounce candle (15.5k shares up to 14.22) was immediately sold back down — no directional resolution in either direction. The 64 bps spread plus last-print-above-ask implies immediate mark-to-bid cost near 0.7%, while the 5m ATR (~2.5% of price) forces stops wide enough that both a breakdown short and a mean-reversion long have poor location and geometry. With elevated but directionless volume and a risk-off tape (VIXY +3.27%) that punishes fading gaps, there is no mechanical edge worth paying the friction for.
